verdict.rationale: Netlify is a platform with a REST API and AI-assistant connections, so issuing scoped credentials to an agent is a fair question to ask of it. The pack, however, never mentions scoped, least-privilege or per-agent API tokens. The nearest items are team-level access and secrets management, a REST API, and connecting AI assistants to an account, and none of these shows credentials that can be restricted in scope for an agent.
